spacing.title: Mastery & pacing
spacing.description: Choose how much students should master before the next lesson unlocks.

gentle.name: Gentle
gentle.desc: Keep students moving. Light reinforcement before the next lesson opens.

balanced.name: Balanced
balanced.desc: Solid retention before advancing. A good default for most courses.

rigorous.name: Rigorous
rigorous.desc: Strong mastery required. Students revisit material until it really sticks.

preview.gentle: Students unlock the next lesson after a few quick reviews, once they've mastered about {{coverage}}% of the material.
preview.balanced: Students unlock the next lesson once they've reliably mastered about {{coverage}}% of the material.
preview.rigorous: Students keep reviewing until they've deeply mastered about {{coverage}}% of the material before the next lesson opens.
preview.custom: Custom settings: students unlock the next lesson once they've mastered about {{coverage}}% of the material.

advanced.help: These are the raw SM-2 parameters. EF (easiness factor, 1.3–2.5) controls how quickly review intervals grow; Unlock EF is the level a student must reach, and Coverage is the share of questions that must reach it before the next lesson unlocks. Most teachers can leave these to the presets above.

persona_traits.help: Optional. Nudge individual tone dials (0–4) on top of the persona preset. This shapes wording only — it never affects scoring, difficulty, or which questions are asked. Leave everything at the preset to use the persona as-is.

trait_hint.warmth: How warm and reassuring the interviewer sounds (0 = detached, 4 = encouraging).
trait_hint.directness: How blunt vs. softened the phrasing is (0 = heavily hedged, 4 = direct).
trait_hint.verbosity: How much the interviewer says (0 = terse, 4 = expansive).
trait_hint.formality: Register and word choice (0 = casual, 4 = formal).
trait_hint.ack_frequency: How often the interviewer acknowledges an answer (0 = rarely, 4 = almost always).

voice_guide.title: AI voice & persona guide
voice_guide.subtitle: How each persona behaves and how each English voice sounds. Persona shapes tone and behaviour; voice sets the spoken sound (English sessions only).

persona_desc.strict: Firm and formal. Presses for precise answers, minimal encouragement — best for rigorous, high-stakes assessment.
persona_desc.neutral: Balanced and professional. Even-handed follow-ups, neither warm nor cold — a safe default.
persona_desc.supportive: Warm and encouraging. Gentle prompts and reassurance — best for lower-pressure or early-stage learners.

voice_guide.voice_note: Vietnamese sessions use the browser voice, so this selection only affects English interviews.

voice_desc.aura-2-thalia-en: Female, clear and crisp. Neutral American accent, easy to follow.
voice_desc.aura-2-andromeda-en: Female, warm and rounded. Friendly, unhurried delivery.
voice_desc.aura-2-helena-en: Female, soft and gentle. Low-pressure, calming tone.
voice_desc.aura-2-apollo-en: Male, confident and clear. Assertive without being harsh.
voice_desc.aura-2-arcas-en: Male, natural and conversational. Relaxed everyday tone.
voice_desc.aura-2-aries-en: Male, energetic and upbeat. Lively pacing.
voice_desc.aura-2-asteria-en: Female, friendly and bright. Approachable, welcoming.
voice_desc.aura-2-athena-en: Female, calm and measured. Composed, steady pacing.
voice_desc.aura-2-hera-en: Female, mature and assured. Authoritative yet warm.
voice_desc.aura-2-hyperion-en: Male, deep and resonant. Serious, weighty tone.
voice_desc.aura-2-luna-en: Female, youthful and light. Casual, fresh feel.
voice_desc.aura-2-orion-en: Male, approachable and even. Neutral, easy default male voice.
voice_desc.aura-2-orpheus-en: Male, expressive and dynamic. More vocal range and emphasis.
voice_desc.aura-2-ophelia-en: Female, professional and polished. Clear, business-like (current default).
voice_desc.aura-2-zeus-en: Male, authoritative and commanding. Strong, formal presence.
voice_desc.aura-2-vesta-en: Female, steady and dependable. Consistent, no-frills delivery.

ai__llm_timeout_seconds.label: LLM timeout — batch (seconds)
ai__llm_timeout_seconds.description: Per-call timeout for background/batch LLM roles (extraction, enrichment, KG extraction, OCR). Raise it for long large-context ingest calls; lower it to fail a stalled endpoint sooner.

ai__llm_interactive_timeout_seconds.label: LLM timeout — interactive (seconds)
ai__llm_interactive_timeout_seconds.description: Per-call timeout for interactive stages where a user waits on a spinner (quiz + interview ideation / generation / validation and the interview runtime roles). Kept tighter than the batch timeout so a stalled endpoint can't hang the user for the full batch limit.

ai__rate_limit_max_attempts.label: Rate-limit (429) max attempts
ai__rate_limit_max_attempts.description: Total attempts for an LLM/embedding call that keeps returning HTTP 429 (rate-limited): 1 initial try plus (N-1) retries. Only 429 is retried inline; all other errors propagate to the job-level retry. 1 disables inline 429 retry.

ai__rate_limit_base_delay_seconds.label: Rate-limit backoff base delay (seconds)
ai__rate_limit_base_delay_seconds.description: Base delay for exponential backoff between 429 retries when the provider sends no Retry-After header. Delay = base * 2^(attempt-1) plus jitter, capped by the max delay below.

ai__rate_limit_max_delay_seconds.label: Rate-limit backoff max delay (seconds)
ai__rate_limit_max_delay_seconds.description: Upper bound on any single wait between 429 retries, applied to both the exponential backoff and a provider-supplied Retry-After.

chunking__max_tokens.label: Window size (tokens)
chunking__max_tokens.description: Upper bound on a single rule-based window before the boundary stage groups them. Larger windows carry more context per embedding but retrieve less precisely.

chunking__overlap_tokens.label: Window overlap (tokens)
chunking__overlap_tokens.description: Tokens repeated between adjacent windows so a fact split across a boundary survives in one of them.

chunking__llm_boundary_enabled.label: LLM decides chunk boundaries
chunking__llm_boundary_enabled.description: Let a lite model group consecutive windows that develop one idea, instead of merging by embedding similarity. Off falls back to the similarity glue.

chunking__llm_boundary_batch_size.label: Boundary batch size (windows)
chunking__llm_boundary_batch_size.description: Windows shown to the boundary model per call. The limit is the model's accuracy over a long list, not the context window.

chunking__llm_boundary_max_carry.label: Boundary carry-over cap (windows)
chunking__llm_boundary_max_carry.description: Most windows that may be withheld from a batch and re-shown in the next one. Bounds the trailing group whose continuation the model could not see.

chunking__glue_threshold.label: Similarity glue threshold
chunking__glue_threshold.description: Cosine similarity above which adjacent windows merge. Only consulted on the fallback path — the LLM boundary stage supersedes it.

chunking__max_window_tokens.label: Merged chunk ceiling (tokens)
chunking__max_window_tokens.description: No merge may produce a chunk larger than this, whichever stage proposes it.

chunking__min_window_tokens.label: Tiny-window absorb floor (tokens)
chunking__min_window_tokens.description: Windows below this are folded into a same-role neighbour so slide-divider artefacts never become their own chunk.

chunking__parallelism.label: Enrichment concurrency
chunking__parallelism.description: Chunks enriched concurrently, each in its own DB session.

chunking__llm_enrichment_enabled.label: LLM enrichment
chunking__llm_enrichment_enabled.description: Section title, context sentence, key concepts and propositions per chunk. Off degrades retrieval sharply — the context sentence is what the embedding is built from.

preprocess__ocr_enabled.label: OCR image-only pages
preprocess__ocr_enabled.description: Read back pages that carry a figure but no text layer. Off loses those pages entirely.

preprocess__ocr_dpi.label: OCR render DPI
preprocess__ocr_dpi.description: Resolution the page is rasterised at before the vision call. Higher helps dense tables and costs more.

preprocess__ocr_advisory_max_pages.label: OCR page warning threshold
preprocess__ocr_advisory_max_pages.description: Logs a warning past this many OCR pages in one document. Advisory only — it does not truncate, because dropping pages deleted content rather than saving money. 0 silences the warning.

preprocess__figure_page_max_words.label: Figure-slide word ceiling
preprocess__figure_page_max_words.description: A page under this many words with real image coverage is treated as a figure and sent to OCR. Raise it if titled diagram slides are still coming through empty.

preprocess__figure_area_min.label: Figure coverage floor
preprocess__figure_area_min.description: Fraction of the page an image must cover to count as content rather than decoration.

knowledge_graph__enabled.label: Build the knowledge graph
knowledge_graph__enabled.description: Extract concepts and relationships per chunk into Neo4j. Off skips the stage and its cost.

retrieval__deprioritized_ratio.label: Summary/review cap divisor
retrieval__deprioritized_ratio.description: At most floor(limit / N) summary, review or front-matter chunks reach the generator. Lower values admit more of them.

notifications__sr_reminder_cooldown_hour.label: Spaced-repetition reminder cooldown (hours)
notifications__sr_reminder_cooldown_hour.description: Minimum gap between spaced-repetition due-card reminders for the same student. The scan still runs hourly to catch new backlog promptly, but a student who already got a reminder inside this window is skipped — so at the default of 24 they get at most one review reminder per day no matter how many cards are overdue.

spaced_repetition__daily_review_cap.label: Daily review cap (cards/day)
spaced_repetition__daily_review_cap.description: Maximum spaced-repetition cards a student is served for review in one day, so a large backlog stays a finishable daily goal instead of an unbounded wall. Cards already reviewed today count toward the cap. This bounds the REVIEW QUEUE only — it never changes lesson unlock eligibility or retention scoring, so progression is unaffected. Set to 0 for no cap (serve the whole backlog).
